text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian loses to Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Biwa Hayahide calmly analyzes the situation. She reminds Narita Brian that she only lost because she's still in her classic year and in the process of growing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes on to claim that the she won't consider herself as truly having won until she wins again next year. The two of them promise each other a rematch in a senior race.
